- High-end ergonomic chairs and modern office furniture

**Steelcase** - steelcase.com
- Commercial office furniture and workplace solutions

- Modern office furniture and workspace design

- Office furniture and architectural interiors

**HON** - hon.com

**IKEA** - ikea.com
- Affordable modern office furniture

**Office Depot** - officedepot.com
- Basic office furniture and supplies

- Office furniture and business solutions

**Wayfair** - wayfair.com
- Wide selection from multiple brands

**Overstock** - overstock.com
- Discounted office furniture

**Amazon Business** - business.amazon.com
- Various brands and price points

## Specialty/Ergonomic Brands

**Humanscale** - humanscale.com
- Ergonomic office products

**Autonomous** - autonomous.ai
